name: berlin52: against the nearest neighbour and the optimum
lesson: A plain genetic algorithm on 52 cities stays far from the optimum, 7,542, and even the best nearest-neighbour tour (the greedy tour tried from every city as the start: 8,181, 8.5 % over the optimum) is hard to beat: after 500 generations only one run in thirty is under it.
lookFor: With this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 500, the limit, at 8,794: 16.6 % over the optimum and 7.5 % above the best nearest-neighbour tour, which the best tour never gets under (it was 37.6 % over the optimum at generation 200 and 25.8 % at 300). Over seeds 1 to 30 the median gap after 500 generations is 15.0 %, one of the 30 runs ends under the best nearest-neighbour tour, at 8,063, 1.4 % under it (none is under it after 300 generations), and none reaches the optimum. Turn on Optimal tour in the route map to see where the best tour differs from it.
